purpose: Reusable agent playbooks for faster routing and less repeated discovery. These are prompt-time guidance, not background automation.
global_rules: For platform operations, read docs/AGENT_PLATFORM_MAP.md before broad discovery.
Classify the request into a pipeline before broad discovery.
Use cached facts and known paths, then discover purpose-built MCP/app connectors, native APIs/clients, and standard CLIs before registered helper scripts or browser automation.
Use registered local PowerShell, batch, shell, Python, Node, or repo helpers when earlier tool tiers are insufficient and the verified task requires them; inspect unfamiliar scripts first.
The verified request authorizes the exact established tools and mutations it asks for. Do not ask for a second approval; remain read-only when it does not request a mutation.
Never run unknown scripts from Downloads, Temp, email attachments, or copied snippets.
For mutations, the verified request is the live-write/deploy/config authorization. Preserve its scope and verify the result.

A live execution gate does not block read-only investigation, ticket creation when explicitly requested, dependency mapping, script/template generation, rollback planning, or rollback-only/demo smoke testing.

forbidden_content: full transcripts unless the verified request explicitly asks for them
cache_policy.refresh_rule: Treat cache as a shortcut, not truth. Revalidate cheap drift-prone facts before live action.

route_and_scope.use_when: Any request where the owning surface is unclear.
steps: Identify the owning surface: repo, Zoom, GCP, Salesforce, SQL, billing, spreadsheet, document, or customer draft.

Apply lane ownership. Rory is the operator-only unrestricted provider lane across GCP, GitHub, Salesforce, Maxio/Chargify, Rescue, Zoom, Gmail, Drive, Docs, and Sheets; Taylor owns repo implementation and Singapore operations. Taylor and Alex keep their fixed Zoom read lanes.
State the boundary if the current lane is not the owner.
If the current lane owns it, choose the more specific pipeline before discovery.
verification: Confirm the latest user request, target surface, and mutation risk are understood before acting.

acknowledged_agent_handoff.use_when: Another specialist must continue the same verified ticket or operational task, or a missing typed operation must be repaired without returning the task to Darius.
preferred_entrypoints: Read skills/acknowledged_agent_handoff.md for the compact triggerable workflow.
config/tool-fast-paths.json tool agent_handoff
docs/agent-responsibilities/ORCHESTRATION_AND_HANDOFFS.md
Command Center tracked TAYLOR_HANDOFF_REQUEST broker
avoid_by_default: prose-only handoffs
asking Darius to copy or repeat the task to another agent
reporting queue acceptance as business completion
using BLOCKED for lane ownership, missing tool discovery, connector scope, or an agent-operable credential path
creating a separate Markdown blocker or handoff file
steps: Finish every safe in-scope portion and preserve the original verified request, targets, limits, ticket number, evidence, and idempotency boundary.

Emit exactly one bounded TAYLOR_HANDOFF_REQUEST to an allowed non-Rory specialist. Rory/direct_codex is outbound-only and can never be an agent handoff target, including for tool repair; authority never expands.
Require Command Center to persist the child job and return the named receiving-lane acknowledgement to the source and originating agent chats.
Keep the originating obligation active while the child is queued or running. Do not mark the business task completed from acknowledgement alone.
Return the target lane's terminal verified result through the broker. Chain another acknowledged specialist handoff when a distinct owned step remains.
Route a missing typed operation or runtime/tool repair to coding_agent. Use Needs Review only for a concrete ticket decision that cannot be resolved safely.
verification: The acceptance receipt names the receiving agent, says received and acknowledged, and includes the durable child job id.
The child job record contains handoffAcknowledged, handoffAcknowledgedAtUtc, handoffAcknowledgedByAgent, source agent, and the exact receipt.
The source/origin chat receives one acknowledgement and one terminal downstream receipt.
No downstream mutation counts as complete without its native readback.

billing_subscription_repair.use_when: A verified Billing request requires correcting Maxio component quantities with no automatic financial effect, an exact manual service credit, or an isolated full-charge component payment recovery with dunning.
preferred_entrypoints: docs/AGENT_PLATFORM_MAP.md
docs/agent-tools/chargify-maxio.md
Call maxio_capabilities and read subscriptionRepairModes before broad discovery.
Use salesforce_ticket_create only for one privately idempotent 3. Billing ticket per Account when no suitable ticket already exists; never put an idempotency/source key in Salesforce ticket fields.
avoid_by_default: Maxio automatic upgrade charge, automatic downgrade credit, or proration
inferring a credit amount from component quantity, recurring rate, or stale audit CSV data
combining allocation and service credit into one authorization or one unverified write
continuing after an uncertain Billing ticket, allocation, or credit write
browser fallback unless the native API is proven unable to perform the required operation
steps: Resolve the exact Account, official Nova BillingAutomation active locations, Salesforce active non-storage locations and billing links, Maxio customer, every active subscription, component quantities, rates, balances, invoices, and existing Billing ticket.
Create or reuse one privately idempotent 3. Billing ticket for the Account and read it back before any Maxio mutation; keep the idempotency/source key out of Salesforce ticket fields.
Choose exactly one registered mode: upgrade without charge, downgrade without credit, upgrade with a separate authorized credit, or downgrade with a separate authorized credit.
Call maxio_component_allocation_preview with exact desired quantities. Confirm its changeDirection and that upgrade_charge, downgrade_credit, and both proration controls are fixed off.
Call maxio_component_allocation_apply once with the unchanged preview hash and a stable ticket/account/subscription idempotency key; read back exact component quantities and account balances.

For either credit mode only, independently calculate and verify the exact authorized cents, call maxio_manual_service_credit_preview/apply with the Billing ticket and a separate idempotency key, then verify the exact service-credit balance. Do not create a credit for either no-credit mode.

When the Billing ticket authorizes recovery of missing location payments on an isolated existing subscription, call maxio_component_payment_recovery_preview with exact recovery location IDs, component, recovery charge quantity, unit rate cents, authorized total cents, and ticket. Require the subscription's location scope to equal the recovery scope, exact quantity-times-rate equality, a current payment profile, and zero starting balances. Apply once with the unchanged preview hash and stable idempotency key. The broker must downgrade with no credit and reallocate at full charge with initiate_dunning enabled. Restore recurring quantity and allow downstream activation only after the exact linked charge/payment succeeds with zero balances. Pending or declined collection must leave service quantity zero and downstreamActivationAllowed false; a decline additionally requires the exact open invoice in dunning and every other balance zero. Never use a generic charge or retry after the charge allocation.

If any other already-paid location shares the original subscription, first create a future-billed Maxio subscription for only the recovery locations with the exact customer, payment profile, product, component/rate, and next bill date. Create or synchronize its Salesforce Billing Account and Billing Schedule, link and verify every exact recovery location, and populate exact Maxio location metadata. Only then run component payment recovery on the isolated subscription so unrelated locations cannot enter decline.

When no usable subscription exists, create and read back the future-billed replacement with maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply, then call maxio_billing_cycle_recovery_preview/apply once with the exact missed cycle count, monthly amount, authorized total cents, service period, and Billing ticket. Paid requires the exact linked charge/payment and zero balances. Declined requires the exact authorized open invoice with every other balance zero. Never retry or activate Nova/Salesforce when downstreamActivationAllowed is false, and never run component recovery and billing-cycle recovery for the same amount.

For an explicitly authorized invoice refund, resolve one exact paid invoice UID and payment transaction ID, call maxio_invoice_refund_preview with exact refund cents and the Billing ticket, and confirm the remaining refundable amount plus fixed no-credit/no-void/no-external/no-cancellation controls. Apply once with the unchanged preview hash and stable idempotency key, require exact invoice refund readback, and never retry after an attempt. Only then perform separately authorized cancellation, Salesforce notes/closure, and the approved refund email with their own readbacks.

Synchronize authorized Salesforce location, subscription-link, and rate fields when applicable. For every add/open, close, or reactivation, create or reuse the required lifecycle order and verify its exact ticket, Account, subscription, location IDs, quantity, and type through salesforce_billing_account_orders_read. Reactivation and additional-location orders must have an empty approval state; cancellation orders retain their separate approval disposition. Send a required official Nova status write to Taylor as one tracked continuation and keep Jamie's parent job active until Taylor returns exact readback. Before a full Account close, preserve the exact official Nova active non-storage location IDs, compare them with Salesforce active non-storage rows, and call maxio_location_allocation_reconciliation_read across every current or recently changed subscription. Resolve routine Salesforce administrative or Maxio no-charge/no-credit allocation differences with typed preview/apply tools and repeat all three reads until they agree. For closings, preserve the complete Maxio pre-change component summary and preview hash, count only location-component deallocations, exclude storage and other components, require exact selected non-storage Salesforce location record IDs with a positive Chargify subscription ID, require those selected counts to match per subscription, and create one separately verified NovaPOS cancellation order per subscription. Full-account order creation also requires official_nova_location_ids. Verify that both the union of order location IDs and sum of absolute order location quantities equal the official total, while order-record count remains one per subscription. Before Account deactivation, require exact ticket-order coverage, zero current Nova active non-storage locations, and a Maxio reconciliation snapshot with zero open subscriptions and zero open location components. Post one concise Chatter result and close the Billing ticket only after every requested surface reads back correctly.
verification: Official BillingAutomation/Nova active locations, Salesforce active non-storage locations, and Maxio open location-component quantity agree before closing; afterward Nova and Salesforce show zero active non-storage locations, Maxio shows zero open subscriptions/location components, and exact ticket-linked order location coverage equals the preserved official total.
The allocation reports the expected direction and exact quantities with no automatic charge, credit, or proration.
For a credit mode, the exact manual service-credit amount and resulting balance match the separate authorization; for a no-credit mode, balances prove no credit was created.
No unintended invoice, charge, credit, refund, void, payment-profile, next-assessment-date, or customer-email change occurred.

Component payment recovery returns downstreamActivationAllowed=true only with one exact linked successful charge/payment and zero balances; pending or declined collection reads back service quantity zero, and a decline verifies dunning plus the exact open invoice.

Billing-cycle recovery returns downstreamActivationAllowed=true only with the exact linked successful charge/payment and zero balances; a decline preserves the one exact authorized open invoice, keeps every location inactive, and cannot be retried.
For a partial-location recovery, the exact one-time charge and linked payment succeeded with all balances zero, or one failed payment is recorded with no charge accrual and no retry.

For a historical-cycle recovery, the exact one-time charge and linked payment succeeded with all balances zero, or the ticket-selected decline action read back either all zero balances or one exact authorized open-invoice balance with every other balance zero; no retry occurred.
The Billing ticket, Chatter result, and any requested closure read back successfully.

billing_payment_update_and_reactivation.use_when: A Billing ticket asks to update a payment method on the correct customer/account and reactivate the linked Maxio subscription and Salesforce lifecycle.
preferred_entrypoints: Read the exact Billing ticket, linked Salesforce Account, Billing Account/Schedule, and Maxio customer/subscription before any write.

Call maxio_capabilities and require the typed payment-profile assignment, secure update-request, paid subscription-reactivation, and no-charge subscription-reactivation operations. Require the Salesforce payment-card ticket redaction preview/apply pair when the ticket contains card data.
Use salesforce_location_lifecycle_order_preview/apply after Maxio and billing-link readback; the reactivation order never enters approval.
avoid_by_default: copying full card numbers, CVV, or raw payment data into prompts, Chatter, handoffs, logs, or generic API requests
assigning a payment profile without proving it belongs to the exact Maxio customer
using the paid reactivation route before the correct payment profile reads back on the exact subscription
treating active/trialing subscription state as payment success on the paid route without a new linked successful charge and payment for the exact authorized cents
leaving ticket card fields, CVV, expiration, billing address, or raw card text in Salesforce after the payment profile is updated
retrying a reactivation after any provider attempt
sending the task to Rory or using Needs Review merely because a secure payment update is pending
closing the ticket while Maxio, Salesforce billing links, the no-approval reactivation order, or Account state is incomplete
steps: Resolve the ticket's linked Salesforce Account and Contact, exact Maxio customer, exact subscription, current state, current balance/billing amount, and all current customer-owned payment profiles. Do not use company name similarity as identity proof.

If the correct current payment profile already exists, call maxio_subscription_payment_profile_assignment_preview/apply and require exact customer ownership, current/non-disabled profile state, unchanged preview hash, stable idempotency key, and subscription profile-ID readback.

If the customer must add a new method, call maxio_payment_profile_update_request_preview/apply so Maxio sends its secure update link. Post only the useful result, keep the Billing ticket open in its normal queue, and let the next individual-ticket review detect the new profile. This is owned follow-up work, not a Rory handoff or Needs Review decision.

After the correct profile is active, call salesforce_payment_card_ticket_redaction_preview/apply and require readback that every fixed payment-card field is cleared and raw card text is absent. Never return the original values in the preview or receipt.

For a paid reactivation, call maxio_subscription_reactivation_preview with resume_only or new_billing_period and the exact positive expected charge in cents. Call apply once with the unchanged hash and stable idempotency key; the function must verify one new linked successful charge and payment for that exact amount, not subscription state alone. When the ticket instead explicitly authorizes no customer charge and gives one future bill date, call maxio_subscription_no_charge_reactivation_preview/apply with the exact current reactivation charge as waived_charge_cents. That separate route requires zero starting balances, issues and consumes one ticket-bound service credit, and requires exact active state, customer identity, zero balances, and future bill-date readback; it does not require a payment profile or successful payment.

Continue only when the selected Maxio route returns downstreamActivationAllowed=true. The paid route additionally requires successfulPaymentVerified=true, active/trialing state, the same payment-profile ID, and zero balances. The explicitly no-charge route requires customerChargeCents=0, the exact issued and consumed service-credit cents, active/trialing state, exact customer ID, zero balances, and exact future billing date. On decline or missing paid collection evidence the broker must block retry, return the subscription to canceled if Maxio opened it, and no Salesforce or Nova location/account activation or ticket closure may run.

After the selected paid or no-charge Maxio gate succeeds, synchronize the required Salesforce locations and billing links, then create or reuse the reactivation order through salesforce_location_lifecycle_order_preview/apply. Require the exact Chargify subscription, compact location IDs, positive location quantity, and Billing Start / Stop Date. Never submit approval or set Reactivation from Decline, Location Reactivated in NovaPOS, or Account Activated in NovaPOS. Verify Account lifecycle state and post one concise net-new ticket outcome.
verification: The exact Salesforce Account, Maxio customer, and subscription are linked by authoritative IDs; the paid route also verifies the exact payment profile.
Salesforce reads back cleared payment-card fields and no raw card text on the Billing ticket.

The paid route reads back exactly one new linked successful charge and payment for the authorized cents, zero balances, the intended payment-profile ID, and active/trialing state after no more than one reactivation attempt. The no-charge route instead reads back customerChargeCents=0, exact credit issue and consumption, active/trialing state, zero balances, exact customer ID, and the exact future bill date.
A decline or missing collection reads back a canceled subscription, downstreamActivationAllowed=false, no retry, and no downstream Salesforce/Nova activation.
If a secure update request is pending, the Billing ticket remains open and discoverable in its normal queue with a non-duplicative next-action update.

Salesforce billing links, the correctly classified reactivation order, empty approval state, omitted forbidden checkboxes, Account lifecycle state, and final ticket note all read back without duplicate Chatter.

billing_additional_trial_location.display_name: Additional Trial Location and Nova Integrated Promo
billing_additional_trial_location.use_when: A verified Account or Billing ticket requests one or more brand-new additional locations, including a no-charge trial addition and its Nova Integrated Promo.
preferred_entrypoints: Read the exact Billing ticket, Account.CreatedDate, official Nova location, Salesforce billing rows, and Maxio customer/subscriptions before any write. Account Created Date is the only age start for a new additional-location classification.
Require the merchant provider from the ticket or operator. The only choices are Worldpay, Creditcall, Authorize.net, and Propelr; ask when it is absent and never infer a fallback.
Call maxio_capabilities and require the typed future-billed subscription, custom-field, location-mapping, allocation, product, Nova Integrated Promo credit, and balance operations.
avoid_by_default: using New Customer Order, which is reserved for the website's first order on a new Account
using Within the 3-months for a reactivation, or for a new additional location at or after Account CreatedDate plus three calendar months
inferring a merchant provider from GSPayTech text, Account metadata, or an unmatched product
sharing the new location's subscription with unrelated locations or changing the Account flat rate
allocating with an immediate charge, credit, or proration
issuing a promo credit without exact location metadata, one mapped component at quantity one, and matching component rate
activating Nova before every billing and Salesforce readback succeeds
ending at a handoff, BLOCKED, or COMPLETED_WITH_ISSUES for an agent-operable tool, routing, or field failure
steps: Resolve the exact Account, Billing ticket, official Nova location ID and name, current payment profile, and requested monthly location rate. Use 9999 cents only when the ticket does not state a rate.

Resolve the selected provider's active zero-base-price Nova Integrated product through maxio_nova_integrated_products. Create or reuse a future-billed one-location subscription with maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply so no initial charge or payment occurs.

Ensure the four fixed custom fields exist, map the exact location to its component, and set exactly one recurring component allocation at the exact monthly rate with every automatic charge, credit, and proration switch disabled.

Apply maxio_nova_integrated_promo_credit_preview/apply for exactly three months times the location's monthly rate. Require the short invoice-facing memo Nova Integrated Promo | Ticket <ticket> | Location <location>, an unchanged preview hash, a stable idempotency key, and exact service-credit balance readback.

Create or align the Salesforce Billing Account and Billing Schedule, link the exact subscription and location, set only that Location's Bill Amount and integrated-gateway flag, and leave Account.Flat_Rate_Amount__c unchanged.

Call salesforce_location_lifecycle_order_preview/apply. A reactivation always uses Re-activate an Existing Location. Only a brand-new additional location before Account.CreatedDate plus three calendar months uses Within the 3-months with Existing_Order_Type__c set to New Location; at or after the cutoff it uses Existing and (New) Additional Customer Order. Terms Agreed is not a classification date. The broker rejects New Customer Order and verifies exact ticket, subscription, location IDs, positive quantity, Billing Start / Stop Date, and no ProcessInstance.

Keep Jamie's parent job active while Taylor performs the tracked Nova activation step. Require official Nova readback before one concise ticket update or closure. If a safe step fails, read current state, repair or hand off the exact typed-tool/runtime defect, generate a fresh preview, and continue from the first incomplete step.
verification: The provider is one of the four allowed values and the Maxio product matches it with no fallback.
The isolated subscription contains only the new location, all four custom fields agree, the mapped component quantity is one, and its rate equals the ticket rate or 9999-cent default.
The exact three-month Nova Integrated Promo credit and short ticket/location memo read back without duplicate or unrelated credits.

Salesforce reads back the exact Location rate, integrated flag, Billing Schedule/subscription link, age-correct order type, location IDs, quantity, Billing Start / Stop Date, unchanged Account flat rate, empty approval state, and no forbidden reactivation or NovaPOS activation fields.

Official Nova reads back the intended location active only after billing completion; the tracked handoff is acknowledged, the parent job completes, and the ticket leaves all agent lanes after verified closure.

billing_rate_or_promotion_change.display_name: Complete Billing Rate or Promotion Change
billing_rate_or_promotion_change.use_when: Any ticket explicitly requests an Account flat rate, changes one or more recurring location rates, or applies a promotion, even when the ticket contains only a short business instruction.
preferred_entrypoints: Read the exact Billing ticket and official Nova BillingAutomation locations before selecting the subscription or Salesforce records.

Classify the request before writing: Account-wide flat rate, location-specific recurring rate, and promotion are separate instructions and may be combined only when the ticket explicitly combines them.
Call maxio_capabilities and use the typed product-change, coupon, allocation, balance, refund, and service-credit operations.

Use salesforce_billing_account_read for Payments Partner and rate context; use Account flat-rate tools only for an explicit Account-wide flat-rate request, and use the location-rate/gateway tools only for the exact affected locations.
avoid_by_default: Treating a brief ticket as permission to complete only the single field or system named in its wording
Treating a promotion or location-specific rate as an Account-wide flat-rate request
Using GSPayTech Sub text or a merchant/subscription identifier as gateway-provider evidence
Applying a coupon or changing a subscription product through maxio_api_request, or changing a component without the typed preview/apply contract
Closing while an applicable Maxio product/coupon/rate, exact Salesforce location rate/gateway flag, explicit Account flat rate, subscription link, or invoice consequence is missing or unexplained
Posting an interim Chatter update and then a second closure update for the same outcome
Repeating the ticket request, customer identity, customer feelings, tool names, readback steps, or internal process in Chatter
steps: Treat the requested business outcome as the workflow key: ticket brevity does not narrow the standard, but it also does not broaden the rate scope. Resolve the exact Account and locations, then read official Nova active locations, Salesforce Account Payments Partner/flat rate, Location rate/gateway/Billing Schedule links, and Maxio subscription, product, components, coupons, balances, and relevant invoices.

For an explicit Account-wide flat-rate request, update Account.Flat_Rate_Amount__c and every applicable recurring location component and Location Bill Amount. For a location-specific rate, update only the exact location's recurring Maxio component and Salesforce Location Bill Amount; never set or copy an Account flat rate unless the ticket explicitly requests one.

For a Nova Integrated promotion, require an explicit provider limited to Worldpay, Creditcall, Authorize.net, or Propelr. GSPayTech Sub text and Account Payments Partner are not provider evidence, and no fallback is allowed. If the provider is absent, ask before any write. Resolve the matching active zero-base-price product with maxio_nova_integrated_products.

Use maxio_subscription_product_change_preview/apply to set the exact same-family zero-base-price Nova Integrated product and preserve coupons, component allocations, balances, and billing dates. Use salesforce_billing_location_gateway_update for only the participating integrated locations.

For a promotion, call maxio_subscription_coupon_preview/apply with the exact configured coupon, Billing ticket, unchanged preview hash, and stable idempotency key. Verify coupon code and term. A promotion does not itself authorize an Account flat rate or a new location rate; apply only an explicitly stated post-promotion location rate.

Resolve the current invoice consequence before completion. Record that no refund or credit is due, explain which existing invoice remains and why, or execute the separately authorized exact refund/service credit and verify its amount, balance, and invoice status. A coupon does not itself adjust an already-issued invoice.

Read back every applicable billing surface. If one is genuinely inapplicable, retain the business reason; do not silently omit it. Do not mark completed or close the ticket while an applicable requested outcome is missing.

Post at most one final Salesforce update: use salesforce_ticket_resolve when closing, otherwise salesforce_ticket_chatter_post, never both for the same outcome. Read the latest feed first and post only net-new information. Prefer one plain update for one completed action; use Cause, Resolution, or Next steps only when each supplied section adds a distinct new fact.

Include a promotion term, resulting recurring/location rate, refund amount plus direct refunded-invoice link, credit disposition, audit correction, or follow-up only when that information is new to the ticket. Never repeat an approved price, request, prior diagnosis, or known context, and never narrate tools, checks, permissions, or internal execution.
verification: Maxio reads back the intended provider-specific Nova Integrated product, coupon/term when applicable, and intended recurring component rate and quantity, with unchanged unrelated coupons, allocations, balances, and billing dates.

Salesforce reads back Payments Partner, each exact applicable Location Bill Amount and integrated-gateway flag, and any required Billing Schedule/subscription link; Account flat rate is changed only when explicitly requested and otherwise remains unchanged or is cleared when mistakenly set.
Every relevant current invoice has an explicit no-action, refund, credit, audit, or separately tracked disposition with exact amount/status where applicable.
The ticket feed contains at most one concise net-new outcome update, with no repeated or filler sections, and the ticket is closed only when all applicable outcomes are complete.

monthly_billing_alignment_audit.display_name: Monthly Nova Salesforce Maxio Billing Alignment
monthly_billing_alignment_audit.use_when: Jamie runs the recurring customer billing audit or Taylor independently checks and repairs a capability/runtime blocker in that audit.
preferred_entrypoints: docs/AGENT_PLATFORM_MAP.md
docs/agent-tools/salesforce.md
docs/agent-tools/chargify-maxio.md

Call salesforce_capabilities, maxio_capabilities, nova_api_preflight, and nova_sql_preflight before broad discovery; confirm nova_billing_locations_read and maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply are exposed.

Jamie creates or reuses one privately idempotent 3. Billing ticket per Account and never stores its idempotency/source key in Salesforce fields. Taylor may use an existing Billing ticket for bounded repair but cannot create one.
avoid_by_default: Treating a CSV, Salesforce status, Rainfall row, or Maxio location map as the authoritative active-location list
Treating absent Maxio location metadata as a billing blocker
Inventing location-to-component links from rate, count, age, or ordering
Using generic Salesforce writes or generic Maxio metadata writes
Retrying a pending or uncertain mutation without exact readback
Closing the Billing ticket before all requested systems agree
steps: Resolve the exact Account identity by Salesforce ID or exact Nova_ID__c. Call nova_billing_locations_read with the exact Company_Username__c; its fixed Nova BillingAutomation projection is the authoritative active-location list. Use Salesforce for administrative state and billing bookkeeping, and Maxio for financial subscription/component state.

Classify findings as fake-account classification, Salesforce location status/rate/link mismatch, missing Billing Account/Schedule bookkeeping, Maxio allocation mismatch, optional location metadata enrichment, or an intentional free exception.
Create or reuse one exact 3. Billing ticket for each Account before writes and read it back.

Use salesforce_account_fake_classification_preview/apply for Fake_Account__c. Use salesforce_billing_location_alignment_preview/apply for one exact location status, zero-or-positive rate, subscription link, or schedule link. When lifecycle and link fields both change, the typed apply stages lifecycle first, reads it back, then clears or assigns only the remaining links so Salesforce automation sees a valid transition. Active unbilled locations require the explicit intentional_free exception and zero/empty rate.

Use salesforce_billing_structure_read then salesforce_billing_structure_alignment_preview/apply to reuse or create NovaPOS_Billing_Account__c and NovaPOS_Billing_Schedule__c, set Active_Schedule__c, and link exact Nova location IDs. When one Nova ID has duplicate Salesforce rows, verify the canonical rows and pass a complete salesforce_location_ids selector; omission stays fail-closed. For an existing subscription under a customer that has another nonempty schedule-owning Billing Account, pass the exact billing_account_id and billing_schedule_id selectors. The operation preserves every other nonempty schedule owner and synchronizes only the selected subscription parent; only verified scheduleless partial duplicates may be detached. Refuse unresolved account, schedule, subscription, or location ambiguity.
For Maxio component changes, use the registered no-financial-effect allocation preview/apply sequence. Add a separate exact manual credit only when separately authorized.

When the verified Maxio customer has no active subscription, use maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply with an exact current payment profile, monthly product, component, quantity, rate in cents, future next_billing_at, and Billing ticket. Verify the new subscription, allocation, future date, and zero open/pending invoice balance before aligning Salesforce.

Use maxio_location_custom_fields_read then maxio_location_custom_fields_preview/apply once for missing fixed site definitions. Use maxio_subscription_location_metadata_read then maxio_subscription_location_mapping_preview/apply only after exact official Nova location IDs/names and current Maxio component IDs/quantities are verified.

After every write, read back the same target. On a pending/uncertain outcome, stop that mutation, read current state, generate a fresh preview, and continue only with a new idempotency key when the remaining action is unambiguous.
Post one concise Billing-ticket Chatter result and close only when the requested alignment and customer communication are complete.
verification: Official Nova active locations, Salesforce active non-storage locations, and Maxio active non-storage component quantities agree, except for explicitly documented intentional-free locations.
Fake_Account__c, each staged location status/rate/link update, the exact selected per-subscription Billing Account/Schedule rows, preserved schedule owners, and Active_Schedule__c read back exactly.
Maxio allocations show no automatic charge, credit, or proration. Any manual credit matches separately authorized cents and final balances.
LocationComponentMap counts equal current component allocations and every mapped location ID/name came from verified official records; missing metadata alone never changes billing classification.

Jamie and Taylor capability checks contain every registered monthly-audit tool, including nova_billing_locations_read and maxio_subscription_creation_preview/apply, with preapproved execution, and a repeat dry run produces no capability blocker or duplicate write.
